an3.44:1.1: “Bhikkhus, in three cases talk flows smoothly.
an3.44:1.3: (1) When the one who teaches the Dhamma experiences the meaning and the Dhamma.
an3.44:1.4: (2) When the one who hears the Dhamma experiences the meaning and the Dhamma.
an3.44:1.5: (3) When both the one who teaches the Dhamma and the one who hears the Dhamma experience the meaning and the Dhamma.
an3.44:1.6: In these three cases talk flows smoothly.”
